request.question: For B21 adoption, should the delegated_review signed-run-proof barrier remain live for older approvals as B17 requires, or be frozen per sealed bundle to preserve historical validity?
request.context: B17 deliberately treats delegated_review as a live trust bar (live_policy_reads_test.go); B21 Constraints says adoption changes no earlier review. No barrier has been weakened. Other implementation work continues; closeout awaits this decision.

options.consequence: Keep the B17 live proof barrier: older records remain immutable but a prefix-only approval may stop satisfying the currently adopted requirement
Freeze the required proof per sealed bundle: older approvals keep their original validity, and only new bundles require signed run proof

reason: Maintainer explicitly chose the live B17 barrier in this session: preserve old records, re-evaluate their validity when adoption requires run proof.
